**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) fried egg, (2) two English muffin halves, (3) milky coffee in the cup.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 105 g of solid food on a small plate, plus a cup of milky coffee, is plausible for one light breakfast. The muffin density is the most uncertain input.
